title: live_review_due drops open packages that have no position_telemetry row: count them with an explicit telemetry_absent state so open_count matches live_review_packet --all-open (PI-20261026-2U1HUCXC-0002)
note: Built on branch lane/ltr-due-telemetry-less. src/runtime/live_review_due.py: open set = open position_telemetry rows UNION journal open order_packages/trades (read_journal_open); every package outside telemetry is listed in telemetry_less with telemetry_state=telemetry_absent and the 4 telemetry events (r_milestone,new_peak,giveback,near_target) in events_could_not_look reason telemetry_absent; daily_floor + market events still evaluate for them. A journal that cannot be read sets journal_open_state=could_not_look and open_count_complete=false (not an empty set). BASELINE MEASURED 2026-10-26T13:30Z on the live VM (running 38f8bcf8b, pre-fix): live_review_due open_count 7; packet --all-open open set 8 (7 telemetry + pkg-6a8e3fb3, gld_pullback_1h on alpaca_paper, found via the trades read, no telemetry row). REPLAY of the new code on rows pulled from the VM (telemetry 300, order_packages 300, trades 2000): open_count 8, id set identical to the packet's 8 (set difference empty). Tests: tests/test_live_review_due.py 3 new + existing pass (17), due_market + wake pass; test_route_requires_diag_token fails here only for ModuleNotFoundError fastapi (sandbox), same on baseline. check_trader_import_closure OK (401 files); module is imported only by src/web/api/routers/diag.py + scripts/ops/live_review_due.py, not the trader. NOT COVERED: prop-ticket open source (packet reads /api/bot/prop/tickets over HTTP; a filled ticket with no order_packages/trades row would still differ); one trade row per package (multi-account packages count once, like the packet). NOT DEPLOYED: the diag route runs in ict-web-api; closes only after a web-api deploy + the check above. CODE PR #20340 = landing hold (Tier-2 by path: pr-landing-guard refuses to self-land src/runtime). Row sits landed_unproven only after #20340 merges + the web-api deploys; until then the fix is NOT merged. Manager: merge #20340, deploy web-api, run the closing observation.

writeback.roadmap: L-ATM: live_review_due open set = telemetry + journal open packages
